name: X9
summary: The A.O. Smith X9 is a stylish 100% RO water purifier with Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) and Alkaline Min-TECH that delivers Baby-Safe, mineral-rich alkaline water.
intro: The A.O. Smith X9 is a premium 100% RO water purifier featuring Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT)for Baby-Safe water and enhanced protection. Its Alkaline Min-TECH enriches purified water with essential minerals while maintaining an alkaline pH for a refreshing, natural taste. Designed with a sleek modern look, digital display, and flexible wall-mount or tabletop installation, the X9 is ideal for borewell, tanker, and mixed water sources with TDS up to 2000 ppm.
